title: Quick Play taps fixed after Free Ride hub overlap
summary: Touch and mouse taps on Quick Play vote cards, GO/Ready and Rematch stopped working after the Free Ride hub landed. Fixed.
details: Cause: since #664 the hub's hit ids 80-85 were checked before the Quick Play panel's. Keyboard and controller were fine. The panel's range is now checked first while it shows; the hub only appears in shared Free Ride rooms, which never show the panel.
Verification: tools/test_engine_quickplay.mjs, which taps those buttons, passed on the PR's build. Host-only evidence; nothing checked on physical phones. PR #674, issue #673.
limitation: No screenshot: the fix is input handling.
